### Checklist

- [ ] The server name includes only the server's name (no tags, prefixes, or superfluous information)
- [ ] The server name is entered in title case (e.g. "Cosmatic Drift", not "cosmatic drift")
- [ ] The server name is not abreviated (e.g. "Wizard's Den", not "WizDen")
- [ ] The server name is in English
- [ ] The address uses the correct scheme (`ss14://` or `ss14s://`)
- [ ] The server address has been tested to be correct
